about_the_game:
ChatFight! is a battle royale for stream VIEWERS. Play the game on stream and let your viewers customize their characters, equip ridiculous outfits, and fight to the death!

Perfect for small groups of friends all the way up to hundreds of people beating each other up in hopes of being the absolute best at a game of PURE RNG. There is zero input from the viewers once their characters are in game, simply sit back and pray to the gods of RNG that your character will be victorious.

Practical Uses For This Game
  • Stream Giveaways
  • tournament Bracket Seeding
  • Entertaining Viewer Interaction
  • Mindless Fun

This game runs along with its website, where you can customize your character, view leaderboards, and keep up with any announcements for the game.

Twitch connectivity requires a Twitch account.
detailed_description:
Out of Early Access!

[h1]ChatFight is out of Early Access![/h1]

After far too long, ChatFight Is finally out of Early Access! Thank you so much to everyone who has played this game and kept it alive for all this time. The game has been out for 3 years now and I decided it's about time I finally get around to adding some more content and some long-requested quality of life features for all the loyal community members.

[h4]Tournament Mode is here![/h4]

Fighters are no longer confined to the chaotic battlefield where they all fight at once, now they can duke it out on the main-stage for everyone to see, one fight at a time. View the bracket and watch each match one-at-a-time to highlight each and every viewer!

1.2.0 Patch Notes

  • Added the ability to switch game modes, allowing for potential additional gamemodes in the future!

    • Currently the choices are Battle Royale and 1v1 Tournament

  • New Gamemode: 1v1 Tournament

    • New map: Colosseum

    • When the tournament starts, a bracket is created. Matchups can be shuffled around, and then matches can either be played one by one or you can toggle "Auto-Advance" to continue the fights.

    • Press V for auto-camera, which simply rotates around the platform

    • Or control the camera manually like BattleRoyale mode.

    • Press Tab to view the bracket at any time.

  • Battle Royale

    • Auto camera is here! No more having to manually follow the action, now you can sit back and interact with your stream while the camera automatically finds the action for you!

    • Press V to switch camera modes

    • Press Left or Right arrow keys to change the auto-follow target

  • Quality of Life Updates

    • Advanced options are available now!

    • Edit the the following aspects of fighters:

      • Fighter Health

      • Max Damage

      • Movement Speed

      • Attack Interval (Attack speed)

      • Heal On Kill (toggle)

      • Heal Amount

      • Allow Overhealing

    • And also customizable bot settings, in case you want the bots to be easier or harder than real players 

      • Different Stats for Bots (toggle)

      • Bot Health

      • Bot Max Damage

[h1]Thank You![/h1]

Seriously, thank you all so much for continuing to play ChatFight! It means so much to me that even after the updates have significantly slowed down, there is still a community of players that continue to play this game every day. Thank you.
